resources.string: caracole answered: %1$d files, %2$s (%3$d listed wrong, left out)
Every 6 hours on Wi-Fi (an unmetered network), when caracole answers at the address; otherwise it does nothing.
Pinch a page to change it: fingers apart for larger text, together for smaller, from 50% to 250% of the size Android\'s font size gives the pages. A sheet\'s own Aa sizes its text on top of this.

Offline, the app shows the pages caracole writes into your library: the library page, each sheet with its viewer (key, capo, diagrams, harmony), songbooks, and the PDFs and Guitar Pro files, which open in another app. With the computer\'s indexes imported, the library page\'s search finds songs on the sites too. Fetching sheets, Export and choosing versions need caracole serve, in the browser.

The sites\' indexes the computer built (caracole index export), merged into the phone\'s, so its search finds songs on Ultimate Guitar, LaCuerda and the other sites with the computer off. From the computer: from caracole serve at the address above. From a file: an export you copied to the phone.
